Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates that are modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two distinct OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate that is modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid and is derived from an aliphatic diisocyanate.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm and its measured surface roughness is greater than 200 nm as defined by root mean square roughness. 

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating is characterized by a root mean square roughness greater than 200 nm.
